remediation.estimated_memory_requirement: Estimated memory ~= parameter_count * bytes_per_param (2 for bf16/fp16, 4 for fp32) plus KV cache and activations; e.g. a 7B model needs ~14 GB in fp16, ~28 GB in fp32, and ~5-6 GB under 4-bit CUDA quantization.
recommended_steps: Run on a machine with a CUDA GPU (>= 16 GB VRAM for a 7B model in bf16/fp16, or use --load-in-4bit on CUDA for ~6 GB), or a CPU host with >= 32 GB RAM for fp32 (slow).

Recommended command on a suitable machine:
  export UGENCE_REAL_MODEL_ID="mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3"
  python -m experiments.hybrid_token_event_attention.real_model.run_real_model \
      --model-id "$UGENCE_REAL_MODEL_ID" --mode smoke --limit 20 --device auto --dtype auto
